signatures.description: Implement a recovery tool for a sharded write-ahead log whose records are checksummed and cross-reference transaction IDs across shards, while crashes may tear the final record on any subset of files. Recovery must preserve every globally committed transaction, reject impossible commit-order histories, and be idempotent across repeated crashes during recovery; specify the invariants and provide adversarial tests for wraparound sequence numbers and duplicate records.
